sections.title: The genus
sections.text: Tilia is a genus of deciduous trees of temperate regions of the Northern Hemisphere. Species vary in size; the plate shows the broad crown, heart-shaped leaves, hanging flower clusters and wing-like bract typical of limes (lindens).

sections.title: Flowers and uses
sections.text: In European species such as T. platyphyllos, fragrant flowers hang from a pale bract and mature into nut-like fruits. Kew records young leaves as edible and flowers as a traditional infusion. “Lime” here means linden, not the citrus fruit.
